title: VN-00 note-normalize recompile, first wave: deterministic boilerplate-note replacement candidates from the causal inventory

scope.summary: Run the registered deterministic projector sarf.note_normalize.v1 over the VN-00 causal-inventory note-normalize population (the top-yield deterministic lane of the VN-00 norm@1 causal inventory: boilerplate sarf/nahw notes recompiled to per-role pedagogy notes) and emit CANDIDATE projection records for the first wave. Purely mechanical: the projector's per-role templates and guards decide every row; the executor exercises zero linguistic judgment.
out_of_scope: any note requiring authoring (stem/TOK rows without a completed P-ROOT-INHERIT chain are left untouched, exactly as the projector specifies)
any live whitelist mutation or deploy (projector output is candidate records for the gated merge seam + two-vote flow)
editing the projector, its registry entry, or its templates

tools_required: tools/lattice_projectors.py (repo copy, run as-is; --self-test must pass before the wave)
the whitelist snapshot input designated by the custody plan (see evidence_policy; NOT a repo file)

candidate_population.selection_rule: The full note-normalize recompile population identified by the VN-00 causal inventory (the 1,559-row deterministic recompile lane; committed snapshot instrumentation shows the projector's class predicate pred_boilerplate_note selecting boilerplate-note segments). The projector's own predicate IS the selection — the executor never hand-picks rows. If the causal-inventory row list is unavailable, the predicate over the designated whitelist snapshot is the authoritative selection and the count difference is reported.

expected_outputs.description: candidate projection records, one per replaced note
projector instrumentation: reachable/replaced/blocked tallies with per-role breakdown
wave report with arithmetic closure and the two-vote handoff list (every candidate rides gate_tier two_vote_required)

evidence_policy.statement: Deterministic derivation: every output note follows mechanically from the segment's attested role (+ inherited root via the certified P-ROOT-INHERIT chain where required), per the registered projector sarf.note_normalize.v1 and its defeater checks (stem_note_requires_inherited_root_chain, no_morphology_beyond_attested_role_or_inherited_root). The whitelist snapshot input is out-of-git private custody: the lane must record the snapshot's designation and sha256 in the wave report per docs/evidence-custody.md section 2 (manifest + hash + reconstruction) — a wave run against an undesignated snapshot is invalid.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: A row with no safe template, a missing root chain, or a firing guard is LEFT UNTOUCHED and tallied — never filled in by hand. Hand-editing any output record voids the wave (determinism is the packet's entire warrant).

guards: The METHOD is the projector; no conclusion transfers by hand — the executor may not write or edit a single note text; only the projector emits them.
Never asserts morphology beyond the segment's own attested role + inherited root (registered defeater check, quoted from the projector registration).
divine_name_exclusion guard: divine-name tokens are excluded by the projector; a divine-name row in the output is a hard failure.
Read-only over the whitelist: projectors never write the whitelist; outputs are candidate records for the gated merge seam and the two-vote flow (gate_tier two_vote_required on every record).
No private corpus names or server paths in any output (FORBIDDEN_LABELS / RM-09): the whitelist snapshot is cited by custody designation + sha256, never by path.
defeaters: Boilerplate look-alike: a note that resembles boilerplate but carries entry-specific content — the class predicate pred_boilerplate_note decides membership; the executor never overrides it in either direction.
Stem/TOK lexical head without a completed root chain: needs-root-chain, left for authoring (wave-1 snapshot precedent: 1 of 27 reachable).
Tanwin-noun/particle roles with no safe template: left untouched, never fabricated (snapshot precedent: the untouched remainder of the 27).
Homograph surfaces: route to two-vote by the projector's standing invariant; never auto-projected.

positive.expectation: boilerplate notes replaced deterministically per role (committed precedent record exists); re-running the wave must reproduce the committed record's note text exactly
same as above — byte-identical reproduction of the committed candidate record

adversarial.expectation: MUST be absent from the output (divine_name_exclusion guard); one present row fails the wave
MUST appear in the untouched/needs-root-chain tally, NOT in the candidates file with an invented root

acceptance_tests.pass_condition: changes only under the three permitted output paths

non_deployment.statement: Candidate projection records only: the whitelist is read-only, no live surface changes, and every record requires the two-vote flow plus the owner-gated merge seam before any deploy. The wave measures and stages; it never ships.

conditions: the designated whitelist snapshot is unavailable or has no custody designation + sha256 (evidence-custody section 3: continuation must not depend on undocumented server-only files)
the projector self-test or unit tests fail
a committed-precedent canary record is NOT reproduced byte-identically (projector drift)
the reached population diverges from the causal-inventory count (1,559) by more than 10% in either direction (inventory drift — re-baseline needed before proceeding)
any divine-name row or hand-authored note is found in the output
escalation_trigger.route: STOP; write the stop-report to qamus/reports/vn00-note-normalize-w1.md and hand back to the Fusha certifier lane; snapshot/custody questions route to the custody plan owner process

definition_of_done: snapshot designation + sha256 recorded in the report (custody rule satisfied)
arithmetic closure holds; per-role breakdown present
all five acceptance tests pass; zero writes outside permitted paths
